notes: April 1 and March 31 stock defaults do not establish shop opening dates. Default antique stock is shown from the July 18 shop opening.
Gear SkillID is decoded through BMD_ItemAddEffectHelp. Consumables use their item help entry; skill cards use the battle-skill ID table.

Material locations combine fixed items, random chests, Persona heart items, enemy drops and other catalog exchanges. Unknown locations remain explicit. Random drops and chest appearances are not guaranteed.
Lowest listed cash price compares catalog shop entries without discounts or future stock eligibility.
